keroseneCan.name: Kerosene Can
keroseneCan.blurb: A lot more damage, and less of you to lose it with.

feedSack.name: Feed Sack
feedSack.blurb: More of you to lose before the field takes you.

saltLick.name: Salt Lick
saltLick.blurb: You knit back together slowly on your own.

barbedWire.name: Barbed Wire
barbedWire.blurb: Anything that touches you takes some back.

tractorPlate.name: Tractor Plate
tractorPlate.blurb: Blows land softer, but you move heavier.

roosterAlarm.name: Rooster Alarm
roosterAlarm.blurb: Sweep up gems and feed from further out.

siloKey.name: Silo Key
siloKey.blurb: Work nodes from further away, and get more from them.

fourLeaf.name: Four-Leaf
fourLeaf.blurb: Better cards and rarer drops turn up more often.

strawHat.name: Straw Hat
strawHat.blurb: Enemies pressing close do less to you.

wetRag.name: Wet Rag
wetRag.blurb: Buys you a moment inside gas before it starts to hurt.

pickaxeHead.name: Better Pickaxe Head
pickaxeHead._note: Steps the pickaxe up the wood -> stone -> iron -> steel -> diamond ladder in nodes.json. Handled in Player.addItem rather than as a stat, because it is a tier not a percentage.
pickaxeHead.blurb: Next pickaxe tier. Mine rock noticeably faster.

axeHead.name: Better Axe Head
axeHead.blurb: Next axe tier. Fell trees and clear crops faster.

prospectorsEye.name: Prospector's Eye
prospectorsEye._note: Widens the proximity harvest reach and the value of what comes out.
prospectorsEye.blurb: Reach further when harvesting, and get more out of every node.

fireRounds.name: Tracer Rounds
fireRounds._note: Every ranged weapon fires fire and leaves a burn. Sets slop slicks alight.
fireRounds.blurb: Every gun you own fires fire. Burns on hit, and sets tar slicks alight.

acidRounds.name: Etched Rounds
acidRounds._note: Every ranged weapon fires acid and leaves a corrosion.
acidRounds.blurb: Every gun you own fires acid. Corrodes for longer than fire burns.

frostRounds.name: Cold Rounds
frostRounds._note: Every ranged weapon fires ice and slows what it hits. Buys space rather than damage.
frostRounds.blurb: Every gun you own fires ice. Slows hard instead of damaging.
